builds.name: Netrunner
builds.description: A legendary netrunner build that hacks everything from the shadows. Legendary quickhacks spread through entire enemy networks, killing entire buildings without firing a single bullet.
builds.descriptionVi: Build netrunner huyền thoại hack mọi thứ từ bóng tối. Quickhack huyền thoại lây lan qua toàn bộ mạng lưới kẻ địch, giết cả tòa nhà mà không cần bắn phát nào.

phases.name: Early Game
steps: Choose Netrunner lifepath for starting quickhacks
Level Intelligence to 10 for tier 2 quickhacks
Buy a decent cyberdeck from the ripperdoc
Invest perk points into Breach Protocol and Quickhacking
Complete the Braindance quest for a free cyberdeck upgrade
Farm access points for quickhack components
stepsVi: Chọn Netrunner cho quickhack khởi đầu
Đầu tư điểm vào Breach Protocol
Farm access point để lấy linh kiện

phases.name: Mid Game
steps: Push Intelligence to 16 for tetraviral and other top quickhacks
Level Technical to 12 for decent crafting
Get the Tetraviral quickhack for legendary spread
Equip the Raven cyberdeck for extra quickhack damage
Invest in Critical Error perk for crit quickhacks
Start crafting legendary quickhacks from components

phases.name: Late Game
steps: Max Intelligence at 20 for legendary quickhacks
Push Technical to 20 for legendary crafting
Get the Netwatch cyberdeck from the cyberpsycho mission
Craft Legendary Short Circuit for 100% crit chance
Use Legendary Contagion to spread through entire buildings
Upload Breach Protocol before every fight for debuffs
stepsVi: Upload Breach Protocol trước mỗi trận

affinities.name: Legendary Short Circuit
affinities.verdict: Best damage quickhack. Triggers on crit for passive damage.
affinities.verdictVi: Quickhack sát thương tốt nhất.

affinities.name: Legendary Contagion
affinities.verdict: Best crowd control. Spreads to every enemy in range.
affinities.verdictVi: Kiểm soát đám đông tốt nhất.

affinities.name: Legendary Synapse Burnout
affinities.verdict: Highest single-target damage. Good for bosses.
affinities.verdictVi: Sát thương đơn mục tiêu cao nhất.

items.name: Netwatch Cyberdeck
items.location: Bought from ripperdoc in Pacifica after the Voodoo Boys quest

items.name: Raven Cyberdeck
items.location: Bought from ripperdoc, tier varies by level

items.name: Tetraviral Quickhack
items.location: Crafted or bought from quickhack vendors

items.name: +2 INT Ripped Muscle
items.location: Ripperdoc in the Glen (only with certain cyberware slots)

tips: Always upload Breach Protocol before combat to reduce enemy quickhack resistance
Ping + Contagion combo clears entire buildings without line of sight
Legendary Short Circuit procs on any crit including weapon crits
Stack Intelligence cyberware mods for maximum RAM and damage
Suicide quickhack is hilarious but expensive on RAM
tipsVi: Luôn upload Breach Protocol trước chiến đấu
Ping + Contagion clear cả tòa nhà
Legendary Short Circuit kích hoạt trên mọi crit
Xếp chồng mod Intelligence để tối đa RAM
Suicide quickhack hài hước nhưng tốn RAM

builds.name: Sandy Katana
builds.description: The iconic Sandevistan katana build. Activate slow time, dash through enemies, and dismember everyone before the first body hits the ground. Highest style-to-damage ratio in Night City.
builds.descriptionVi: Build Sandevistan katana huyền thoại. Kích hoạt làm chậm thời gian, lao qua kẻ địch và chặt xác trước khi xác đầu tiên chạm đất.

phases.name: Early Game
steps: Level Reflexes to 12 for blade perks
Buy a basic katana from a weapon vendor
Complete the Heist to unlock crafting
Get the Satori katana during the Heist (secret)
Invest in Blade and Reflex perks
stepsVi: Lấy Satori katana bí mật trong Heist
Đầu tư Blade và Reflex perks

phases.name: Mid Game
steps: Push Reflexes to 16 for high-tier Sandevistan
Get a Mk.3 or Mk.4 Sandevistan from ripperdoc
Level Technical to 12 for decent crafting
Find Byakko or Jinchu-Maru legendary katana
Invest in the Attack Mitigation skill tree
Equip cyberware for crit rate and melee damage

phases.name: Late Game
steps: Get the Apogee Sandevistan from Dogtown DLC
Push Technical to 18 for legendary crafting
Equip the iconic Scalpel katana for 100% crit during Sandy
Use the QianT Warp Dancer Sandevistan for 2 slow-time charges
Attack in Sandevistan + katana = every enemy dies before Sandy ends
stepsVi: Lấy Apogee Sandevistan từ Dogtown DLC
Tấn công trong Sandy = mọi kẻ địch chết

affinities.name: Jinchu-Maru
affinities.verdict: Best base katana. Guaranteed crits while Sandy active.
affinities.verdictVi: Katana cơ bản tốt nhất. Crit đảm bảo khi Sandy.

affinities.name: Scalpel
affinities.verdict: Iconic DLC katana with 100% crit during Sandevistan.
affinities.verdictVi: Katana DLC 100% crit khi Sandevistan.

affinities.name: Byakko
affinities.verdict: Lunge attack gap closer. Good for chasing enemies.
affinities.verdictVi: Đòn lao tiếp cận kẻ địch.

items.name: Apogee Sandevistan
items.location: Dogtown ripperdoc, requires high Street Cred

items.name: Scalpel
items.location: Dogtown, looted from a crate during the DLC main quest
items.locationVi: Dogtown trong nhiệm vụ chính DLC

items.name: Satori Katana
items.location: The Heist mission, in Yorinobu's penthouse behind the bar
items.locationVi: Nhiệm vụ Heist, penthouse của Yorinobu

items.name: Byakko
items.location: Dropped by a cyberpsycho in the Badlands or crafted
items.locationVi: Cyberpsycho ở Badlands hoặc chế tạo

items.name: Legendary Optical Camo
items.locationVi: Ripperdoc yêu cầu Street Cred cao

tips: Sandevistan + Optical Camo = complete invisibility while slowed
Apogee Sandevistan gives the most slow time with the lowest cooldown
Scalpel katana guarantees crits during Sandevistan — mandatory for min-max
Use the 'Defencest' perk to block bullets while sprinting at enemies
Air dashes and double jump are essential mobility for this build
tipsVi: Sandevistan + Optical Camo = tàng hình khi chậm thời gian
Apogee Sandevistan có cooldown thấp nhất
Scalpel crit 100% khi Sandy
Dùng Defencest perk để chặn đạn khi chạy
Air dash và double jump thiết yếu cho build này

builds.name: Berserk Shotgun
builds.description: A Body build using Berserk cyberware and a devastating shotgun. Activate Berserk, ignore damage, and blast everything with unlimited stamina. The walking tank build.
builds.descriptionVi: Build Body với Berserk và shotgun hủy diệt. Kích hoạt Berserk, bỏ qua sát thương, và bắn nổ mọi thứ với stamina vô hạn. Build xe tăng biết đi.

phases.name: Early Game
steps: Pick Nomad for high Body start
Level Body to 10 for Annihilation perks
Use a double-barrel shotgun as your primary
Invest in Shotgun and Athletics perks
Find the Mox shotgun from Lizzie's Bar
stepsVi: Đầu tư Shotgun và Athletics perks
Tìm Mox shotgun từ Lizzie's Bar

phases.name: Mid Game
steps: Push Body to 16 for Berserk cyberware
Get Berserk Mk.3 or Mk.4 from ripperdoc
Find the Guts shotgun — a powerful unique
Level Technical to 10 for armor crafting
Equip cyberware for armor and health
stepsVi: Đầu tư Bio-Monitor tự động hồi máu
Trang bị cyberware giáp và máu

phases.name: Late Game
steps: Max Body at 20 for best Berserk and health
Get the Militech Berserk Mk.5 from Dogtown
Push Technical to 15 for armor mods
Find the iconic 'Order' shotgun from DLC
Every shot staggers enemies — chain stunlock entire groups
stepsVi: Lấy Militech Berserk Mk.5 từ Dogtown

affinities.name: Mox Shotgun
affinities.verdict: Best early shotgun. Electrifies enemies for stunning.
affinities.verdictVi: Shotgun đầu game tốt nhất.

affinities.name: Guts
affinities.verdict: Extremely high damage but slow reload. Best for Berserk.
affinities.verdictVi: Sát thương cực cao. Tốt nhất với Berserk.

affinities.name: Order
affinities.verdict: DLC iconic. Tech shotgun with charge mechanic.
affinities.verdictVi: Shotgun DLC có cơ chế tích.

items.name: Order
items.location: Dogtown, reward from a DLC gig
items.locationVi: Dogtown phần thưởng nhiệm vụ DLC

items.name: Guts
items.location: The Hunt quest from River Ward
items.locationVi: Nhiệm vụ Hunt của River Ward

tips: Berserk gives damage immunity, infinite stamina, and knockdown resistance
Shotguns stagger enemies on hit — Berserk + shotgun = perma-stun
Use the 'Spontaneous Obliteration' perk for explosions on kill
The Order tech shotgun can be charged for a devastating 8-pellet blast
Bio-Monitor auto-heals at 30% HP - essential for Berserk uptime
tipsVi: Berserk cho miễn nhiễm sát thương và stamina vô hạn
Shotgun làm choáng kẻ địch
Dùng Spontaneous Obliteration perk
Order shotgun có thể tích cho 8 viên
Bio-Monitor tự hồi ở 30% máu

builds.name: Tech Sniper
builds.description: A Technical build using tech sniper rifles that shoot through walls. Ping enemies behind cover, charge your shot, and headshot them through solid concrete. The ultimate stealth marksman.
builds.descriptionVi: Build Technical với súng bắn tỉa công nghệ xuyên tường. Ping kẻ địch sau nấp, tích đạn và headshot xuyên bê tông. Xạ thủ tàng hình tối thượng.

phases.name: Early Game
steps: Level Technical to 10 for tech weapon perks
Get a basic tech sniper rifle from a vendor
Level Cool to 8 for stealth perks
Invest in the Crafting tree for upgrades
Silence a pistol for backup stealth kills
stepsVi: Gắn giảm thanh cho súng lục

phases.name: Mid Game
steps: Push Technical to 16 for better charge mechanics
Level Cool to 14 for silent and deadly perk
Get the Breakthrough iconic tech sniper
Invest in the Sniper tree for damage
Equip the Ping quickhack to see through walls

phases.name: Late Game
steps: Max Technical at 20 for legendary crafting
Push Cool to 18 for max stealth and crit
Use Breakthrough's charge to shoot through any wall
Ping + Breakthrough = kill everyone through walls
Get the 'Rasetsu' sniper from DLC for bosses
Stack crit damage mods on your sniper

affinities.name: Breakthrough
affinities.verdict: Best wall-penetrating sniper. Shoots through everything.
affinities.verdictVi: Súng bắn tỉa xuyên tường tốt nhất.

affinities.name: Rasetsu
affinities.verdict: DLC sniper with explosive rounds. Better for open fights.
affinities.verdictVi: Súng DLC đạn nổ. Tốt cho đánh trực diện.

items.name: Breakthrough
items.location: Crafted or found in the Badlands during main quest
items.locationVi: Chế tạo hoặc tìm ở Badlands

items.name: Rasetsu
items.location: Dogtown DLC, found during the main DLC quest

tips: Ping + Breakthrough is the best combo in the game — see everyone through walls and kill them
Tech weapons ignore armor when fully charged
Always shoot from stealth for the 2x headshot multiplier
The 'Silent and Deadly' perk keeps you hidden even after a kill
Stack crit damage on your sniper for one-shot headshots on any enemy
tipsVi: Ping + Breakthrough = thấy và giết qua tường
Tech weapon bỏ qua giáp khi tích đầy
Luôn bắn từ tàng hình cho headshot x2
Perk Silent and Deadly giữ bạn ẩn
Xếp crit damage cho one-shot headshot

builds.name: Smart Gun
builds.description: A Smart Weapon build using the iconic Skippy and other homing weapons. Bullets curve around corners and track enemies. Point vaguely in the direction of enemies and watch them fall.
builds.descriptionVi: Build Smart Weapon với Skippy huyền thoại và vũ khí tự tìm đường. Đạn bay vòng qua góc và truy đuổi kẻ địch. Chỉ cần trỏ đại là kẻ địch ngã.

phases.name: Early Game
steps: Level Reflexes to 10 for smart weapon perks
Find the iconic Skippy pistol in a side gig
Get the Shingen smart submachine gun
Invest in Handguns or Submachine Guns perks
Equip a smart link cyberware from a ripperdoc
stepsVi: Đầu tư Handguns hoặc SMG perks

phases.name: Mid Game
steps: Push Reflexes to 12 for better smart tracking
Level Technical to 12 for crafting upgrades
Equip the legendary smart link from ripperdoc
Find the Prototype: Shingen Mark V

phases.name: Late Game
steps: Push Reflexes to 15 for max bullet speed
Skippy in headshot mode for auto-aim headshots
Use bullet deflection cyberware for defense
Spray from cover and let the smart tracking do the work
stepsVi: Skippy chế độ headshot tự động
Bắn từ nấp và để đạn tự tìm đường

affinities.name: Skippy (Headshot)
affinities.verdict: Auto-aims for headshots. Most forgiving weapon in the game.
affinities.verdictVi: Tự động ngắm đầu. Vũ khí dễ nhất game.

affinities.name: Shingen Mark V
affinities.verdict: Homing SMG with high fire rate. Melts groups.
affinities.verdictVi: SMG tự tìm đường tốc độ cao.

affinities.name: Ashura Smart Sniper
affinities.verdict: Smart sniper rifle. Tracks headshots from any range.
affinities.verdictVi: Súng bắn tỉa thông minh.

items.name: Skippy
items.location: Side gig 'The Gift' from Regina in Haymarket
items.locationVi: Nhiệm vụ phụ 'The Gift' từ Regina

items.name: Prototype: Shingen Mark V
items.location: Dropped by the Wraiths during a Panam side quest
items.locationVi: Rơi từ Wraiths trong nhiệm vụ Panam

items.name: Ashura Smart Sniper
items.location: Crafted or bought from weapon vendors

tips: Skippy in headshot mode is the easiest weapon in the game — point and click kills
Smart weapons ignore all bullet drop and travel time to locked targets
Use the Hand-Launched Smart Bomb for crowd control
Prototype Shingen Mark V has the best bullet tracking of any smart weapon
Keep Skippy on headshot mode until it inevitably switches to "puppy-loving pacifist"
tipsVi: Skippy chế độ headshot là vũ khí dễ nhất game
Smart weapon bỏ qua độ rơi đạn
Dùng Hand-Launched Smart Bomb cho đám đông
Shingen Mark V có tracking tốt nhất
Giữ Skippy chế độ headshot

builds.name: Blade Runner
builds.description: A trend-setting build inspired by the Blade Runner aesthetic. Focuses on monowire and mantis blades with a dystopian cyberpunk look. High style, high damage, all attitude.
builds.descriptionVi: Build theo phong cách Blade Runner. Tập trung vào monowire và mantis blades với vẻ ngoài dystopian. Phong cách cao, sát thương cao, đầy thái độ.

phases.name: Early Game
steps: Level Reflexes to 12 for blade perks
Get Mantis Blades from any ripperdoc
Use a katana as backup weapon
Equip thermal damage on your mantis blades
stepsVi: Gắn sát thương nhiệt cho mantis blades

phases.name: Mid Game
steps: Push Reflexes to 16 for aerial perks
Get the Monowire from ripperdoc (DLC upgrade)
Equip the Legendary Monowire with electrical damage
Invest in the new Relic perks from DLC
Get Optical Camo for the Blade Runner aesthetic
stepsVi: Đầu tư Relic perks từ DLC

phases.name: Late Game
steps: Get the Arasaka cyberarms for style
Equip the iconic Monowire: The Electric Chair
Use Mantis Blade lunge attacks for gap closing
Stay in Optical Camo for full Blade Runner fantasy
Use Cold Blood perks for speed boost after kills
stepsVi: Bật Optical Camo cho phong cách
Dùng Cold Blood tăng tốc sau kill

affinities.name: Electric Monowire
affinities.verdict: Best crowd control. Chains electrical damage between enemies.
affinities.verdictVi: Kiểm soát đám đông tốt nhất.

affinities.name: Thermal Mantis Blades
affinities.verdict: High single-target damage. Burns enemies over time.
affinities.verdictVi: Sát thương đơn mục tiêu cao.

items.name: Legendary Monowire
items.location: Ripperdoc in Dogtown or City Center
items.locationVi: Ripperdoc ở Dogtown hoặc City Center

items.name: The Electric Chair Monowire mod
items.location: Dogtown, found in a hidden cache

tips: Monowire was completely reworked in 2.0 — it now scales with Reflexes and is amazing
Mantis Blade air dashes and lunges make you nearly untouchable
Use Optical Camo to close distance before engaging

Stack 'Dragon Strike' and 'Jugular' perks for bleed on blade attacks

builds.name: Stealth Knife Thrower
builds.description: A stealth build using throwing knives with the Cold Blood tree. Throw knives for silent kills from a distance, retrieve them from bodies, and chain kills with Cold Blood speed boosts.
builds.descriptionVi: Build tàng hình ném dao với Cold Blood. Ném dao giết lặng từ xa, nhặt lại và tăng tốc với Cold Blood.

Buy throwing knives from weapon vendor
Invest in Ninjutsu and Cold Blood trees
Complete the Heist for the neuroport

phases.name: Mid Game

phases.name: Late Game

Use optical camo for resetting stealth

affinities.name: Nehan

Juggler perk refunds knives on hit not just kill — keep throwing
tipsVi: Ném hai dao rồi dùng optical camo reset
Stinger tự hồi khi headshot

builds.name: Gorilla Arms Brawler
builds.description: A meme Body build using Gorilla Arms for maximum punching power. Beat every enemy to death with your bare fists. Works surprisingly well after the 2.0 rework with the right perks.
builds.descriptionVi: Build Body meme với Gorilla Arms. Đấm chết mọi kẻ địch bằng tay không. Bất ngờ hiệu quả sau bản 2.0 với perk đúng.

steps: Level Body to 10 for brawler perks
Get Gorilla Arms from a ripperdoc

phases.name: Mid Game
steps: Get the legendary Gorilla Arms with electrical damage

phases.name: Late Game

Push Technical to 15 for legendary armor mods
Use Berserk + Gorilla Arms for super punch mode

Đấm qua Beat on the Brat cuối cùng

affinities.verdict: Poisons enemies. Good for sustained fights.
affinities.verdictVi: Đầu độc kẻ địch.
